insurer: THE NEW INDIA ASSURANCE CO. LTD.

room_rent.note: Clause 3.1(a) covers single AC room. If higher room opted, proportionate deduction applies on associate medical expenses. Zone II insured taking treatment in Zone I attracts 10% co-pay.

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges covered under Clause 3.1(b) with no explicit sub-limit mentioned; covered at actuals subject to sum insured.

copayment.display: 10% if Zone II insured treats in Zone I
copayment.note: No co-pay for Zone I insured or for accidents. 10% co-pay applies only when Zone II policyholder takes treatment in Zone I cities. No co-pay on sub-limited illnesses.

sub_limits.display: Cataract, modern treatments, hazardous sports, ARMD, mental illness, genetic disorders, life support, puberty/menopause capped
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 10% of SI or ₹50k whichever less. Modern treatments: 5–25% of SI per procedure. Hazardous sports: 10% of SI. Life support: 25% SI/15 days. Puberty/menopause: 25% SI. ARMD: 20% SI. Genetic: 25% SI. Mental illness: 25% SI. Congenital external: 10% of avg SI.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: PED defined as conditions diagnosed or treated within 24 months prior to policy inception. Waiting period is 24 months of continuous coverage.

specific_disease_waiting.display: 12 months (most); 24 months (joint replacement, mental illness, ARMD, genetic)
specific_disease_waiting.note: 90 days for diabetes, hypertension, cardiac conditions. 12 months for cataract, hernia, stones, skin disorders etc. 24 months for joint replacement, osteoarthritis, mental illness, ARMD, genetic diseases, external congenital.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded under Clause 4.4.15 (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: 25% CB per claim-free year, max 100%. Reduced at same rate if claim made. Option to take premium discount in lieu of CB at renewal.

restoration.note: Reinstated SI available once per policy period upon full exhaustion, for illnesses/injuries other than those for which claim was paid. Only for individual SI basis policies. Not available for modern treatments. Unutilised amount not carried forward.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation medical expenses covered up to 60 days prior to admission for the same condition.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation medical expenses covered up to 90 days from date of discharge for the same condition.

day_care.display: Listed day-care procedures (280+ listed in Annexure I)
day_care.note: Extensive list of day-care procedures in Annexure I covering ENT, ophthalmology, oncology, urology, gynaecology, orthopaedics, general surgery and others.

domiciliary.note: Clause 4.4.17 explicitly excludes domiciliary hospitalisation expenses.

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment (Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy) covered up to 100% of SI per policy year under Clause 3.15.

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation expenses of donor covered under Clause 3.4, excluding cost of organ itself. Combined donor + recipient liability capped at available SI.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered for shifting to hospital or between hospitals, and also for discharge to residence if certified by doctor. Each leg capped at 1% of SI up to ₹5,000.

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments listed under Clause 3.11 with individual sub-limits ranging from 5% SI/₹30k (IONM) to 25% SI/₹2L (deep brain stimulation, robotic surgery etc.). Restoration not available for modern treatments.

consumables.note: Consumables such as gloves, masks, crepe bandages, diapers etc. are explicitly listed under Annexure II List I as non-payable items.

global_cover.note: Clause 5.18 and 4.4.27 restrict coverage to treatment within India only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim or policy can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly premium payment mode and 30 days for all other modes. Coverage not available during grace period.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy document for new individual policies of 1 year or more. Not applicable on renewals or porting.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers permitted as per IRDAI guidelines with credit for PED waiting, specific waiting periods and moratorium.

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary hospitalisation, treatment outside India, acupressure/acupuncture/magnetic therapy, external prosthetics/hearing aids, CPAP/BIPAP at home, vaccination, self-inflicted injury

optional_riders.note: No optional riders or add-on covers described in the policy document.
